title: Rise Of The Ghasts
description: This texture pack just makes Ghasts more pleasant... Before they BLOW YOU UP!
body:
Hello! 👋
Do you dislike how the vanilla Ghast looks? 👎

Then Rise of the Ghasts is the perfect texture pack for you! 🫵🔥

This pack gives the Ghast a brand-new texture that makes it look cooler, cleaner, and more pleasant to look at 😎👻
Vanilla Ghasts can be a bit… painful to the eyeballs 👎👁️, so I decided to give them a fresh upgrade!

Ghasts are one of my favorite mobs in Minecraft 🩷👍, so I wanted them to look as good as they deserve.

🎨 How it was made

This pack was inspired by the thumbnail of this video:
📺 [Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=x-huPxEJ11s&t=696s)

I took the original Minecraft Ghast texture into Photoshop, grabbed the brush 🖌️🎨, and created this new design!

📈 Update! (1.1)

Ghasts now look more DRY! so they look like there sprung right from the dryed Ghast block.🔥
